history.notes: The built-in synth shows its new name, Basic, at the top of the window too.

Ctrl+D copies the chosen stretch, and the copy comes out selected. Choose how the mouse works in the MIDI editor: Draw (like FL Studio) or Select (like Ableton Live). Drag one velocity bar to change every selected note. Pick the length of new notes. The built-in synth is now called Basic, with a new look.

Add notes with a click in the MIDI editor, and mark several parts to keep with the scissors. More hotkeys, like Ctrl+S to save. Effects open beside the instrument, with undo and redo. Make your own plugin lists. Pick up where you left off when the app starts.

New features
- Count-in for recording in the MIDI editor: turn on the hand button beside Record, pick 1, 2, 3, 4 or 8 beats, and recording starts after the count.
- MIDI Replay has a new look.
